title: KyuSMP
description: A Create-focused modpack put together for a whitelisted minecraft server. Should be singleplayer-friendly but may have higher performance impact on lower-end hardware.
body:
A modpack which consists of mostly [create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)+, [farmer's delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)+ and some other mods that have been mashed together for a whitelisted minecraft server. (Feel free to play it on your own aswell of course)

Recommended ram: **8-10GB**

# Version 2.2.0
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and many of its many addons
> Who doesn't love making massive abominations of bits and bobs that produce almost every single resource in the known universe? With the addition of [Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics) you can also make some really cool vehicles and airships or even entire flying bases!
- [Spice of Life](https://modrinth.com/mod/spice-of-life-onion) and [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)
> Players can make and eat a high variety foods to gain more hearts and other neat buffs.
- No more mending.
> You have all those resources, might aswell use some!
> Mending has been removed and replaced with [Longevity](https://modrinth.com/mod/longevity-enchantment) which increases durability instead of letting you endlessly repair your equipment with experience.
- Terralith + Tectonic
> More scenic world generation!

# Credits (will update if needed)

- [Create Aeronautics: Delivery Required](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics-delivery-required) - an absolutely awesome mod that deserves its own shoutout! Adds a fun gameplay loop, a sink for the endless resources you'll be generating and a way to gain currency from [Create Numismatics](https://modrinth.com/mod/numismatics)

Feel free to join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/cYa9VNz9zF) for suggestions and bug reports!
